name: Elendia Veilt
original_name: エレンディア・ヴェイト
source:
Idealistic researcher elf

Adventurer/researcher hailing form the Radonea kingdom belonging to guild Hermit. Falcos friend and the person overseeing Stellas treatment. Elen was also the person who came up the curing method for Stella. Considered part of the Caro family even though she has her own family too. Moves to Elysium Hermits branch to help her real father in some research. Ofcourse she is also there to help the others in earning the Stellas treatment cost.

Acts levelheadedly but deep down hold insecurities regarding her research.
